description: Get current EV/Revenue, EV/EBIT, P/E, Price/Sales and Price/Book with peer median, quartiles and sample size; REITs add verified company-stated P/FFO and P/AFFO, and a filer with a verified reconciliation adds EV over its stated Adjusted EBITDA. TTM flows use four discrete fiscal quarters or an exact annual-plus-YTD bridge; annual-only figures are not TTM. P/E uses validated diluted EPS or income available to common, with the basis named. Enterprise value uses same-date reported debt, cash and tagged short-term investments. Price/Sales and Price/Book use market cap over TTM revenue and latest tagged equity. Inputs must reconcile, share one split basis and be in USD; missing inputs are never estimated; a company without a provable ratio still lists its figures. The peer cohort excludes the company and uses similar-size industry peers when sufficient, else the full industry. The response dates every figure and names its cohort basis. Use GetValuationMultiplesHistory for history.
name: GetValuationMultiples
title: Valuation Multiples
